description: The bar chart, titled "# tasks" on the horizontal axis, illustrates the number of tasks associated with various language families and individual languages, likely representing the scope of linguistic analysis in a study on multilingual BERT models. The vertical axis lists language groups and specific languages, including IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque, with an additional light gray bar at the top labeled "IE-Romance" that extends beyond the main data range. The horizontal axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10, representing the count of tasks. The bars are colored differently for each category, with the longest bar corresponding to the IE-Romance group, which extends to approximately 79 tasks. The IE-Germanic group follows with a value of about 45 tasks. The Uralic group has approximately 20 tasks, while the IE-Baltic and IE-other groups have values of around 17 and 15, respectively. The IE-Indic group shows about 10 tasks, the Semitic group around 8, the Turkic group about 5, and the Basque group has the fewest tasks, at approximately 4. The bars are arranged in descending order of task count, with the IE-Romance group at the top, followed by IE-Germanic, and so on.
